SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. POLICE REGISTRY

Date February 18, 19 29
File No.

Subject (in full) Visit of Suspected Soviet Agent to Shanghai.

Made by T. P. J. Medvedeff Forwarded by H. Gweno A. C. Pol.

Sir,
The undermentioned suspected Soviet Agent arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin on February 12, 1929 and left again for the latter
port in the S.S. "Dairen Maru" on February 17, 1929.

Michael Nikitich Ershoff. Employed in the Traffic Department
of the Chinese Eastern Railway at
Harbin. Supposed to have come to
Shanghai in search of his wife who
left him sometime ago. During his
stay here, he resided at 163 East
Seward Road.

T. Medvedeff
T. P. J.
